title: Vessels S9: play tests, the guide record and their fixes
description:
S9 plays the whole vessel system in game, end to end, through Luminari Web, per
`docs/ongoing-projects/vessels-ships.md` (Phase 9 (S9) progress), and fixes every
defect found on the way.

## The play record (for S10)

- All 17 chapters played in the namespace harness on a disposable reload of the
  development dump: Kohdee staged, Vesselmate and a second mortal (Brinewick, on
  the Sailtest test account) played.
- `docs/ongoing-projects/guide-notes.md`: one section per chapter, with each
  screenshot's character, exact commands, what it shows and what had to be true
  first, then prices, timings, refusals and tips.
- `docs/ongoing-projects/guide-screenshots/`: 79 PNG captures in play order
  (`NN-chapter-moment.png`, each under 500 KB). Only chapter 16's come from the
  staff session; none shows the master account.

## Fixes (one commit each, each with a production-linked test or gate check, help in both places and `VESSEL_SYSTEM.md` where they changed)

The finding / fix / commit table is in the progress section. In brief:

- Shipyard and hull: `shipbrowse` column overflow (`fbeed236c`), the staff-only
  spawn line (`7955887f5`), every hull glowing and humming (`b821585ca`), the
  interior keeping the old name after christening (`6504c9b82`), christening help
  (`61aed49c7`), self-contradicting interior exits (`49ab1fb55`, `b1f90991e`),
  rafts with mess halls (`56295c437`).
- Sailing and passage: lookout by contact ID and from the one contact list
  (`e7018c0a3`, `a641246e0`), the piloted hull's speed report (`6ca2b5a71`),
  disembark wording (`3d9ddfa3d`), public hulls' helms held by their NPC pilot
  (`9a3be3361`), `help ships` and the ferry entry (`a9c3ad413`, `753344f9a`),
  casting-off refusals (`2a3809ee8`), the dock-fee port name (`5a70fdc3d`),
  autopilot arrival before the fee pause (`548d41cf2`), pilot announcements
  (`530fdd072`), ADDTOROUTE help (`1aba0729c`), people put off a hull landing at
  stale coordinates (`d97a724bd`), the summoned hull's owner told she made port
  (`34bfe9a51`), the boat's off-water refusal (`6fc108a55`).
- Trade: freight only to real ports and at the port the hull lies in
  (`d293b3774`, `bf8af8153`), the freight bond that ends free cargo
  (`862c944a3`), goods found by any word of their name and admiralty business
  ashore (`ab2701d0b`).
- Combat and prizes: Neutral Colors article (`aa8c42649`), holed means crippled
  (`a973e22d2`), empty-hull boarding wording (`c206f6140`), plunder wording
  (`c4e795d6e`), the strongbox key's keywords (`1182093b4`), the group forfeit
  for turning on a groupmate's ship (`a3e448e2c`), the bounty grammar
  (`420e8735b`), gunfire "in port" (`c428116cf`), contacts found by any word of
  their name (`d8fb17b16`).
- Vehicles and the living world: vehicles listed by `look` (`03f6b6a76`), `tgo`
  carrying its rider (`1ad24f5df`), vehicles loading only at the surface
  (`b7681232e`), the Blackwake derelict's chain starting with a plain `search`
  (`68d3f1230`).

## In the local client (not pushed, by plan)

`/home/aiwithapex/projects/luminariweb`, branch `fix/literal-carets` from `main`
`be28d96`: `bb7c707` keeps carets in game output literal (the tactical chart's
`^` land cells were read as color codes). Review with
`git log -p be28d96..fix/literal-carets` there.

## Verification

Details in the progress section's Verification paragraph:

- `make test-all` with the database cases: 1,984 CuTest cases and the
  protocol harness's 32 pass.
- The vessel help verifier passes all seven checks on a fresh dump reload.
- All 20 live gates of S8's run pass in the namespace harness. Two gates'
  expectations were updated for S9's own rewording (`53a1c603f`).
- The local CI matrix passes all 33 jobs on `fab5cb9ca`, after fixes for a
  clang-tidy dead store (`13305c989`) and two test-fixture leaks
  (`fab5cb9ca`) that its first run found. The head adds only the record.
- Client: lint clean, 353 tests and the build pass.

## After merge

- Sync the S9 help to production. Ten entries changed (by first keyword):
  ADDTOROUTE, ANCHOR (the vessel commands), BATTLE-STATIONS (combat), BOATS
  (the rewritten ferry entry; SHIPS moves to VESSELS), BOUNTY, CARGO, CONTRACTS,
  LAND-VEHICLES, LOADVEHICLE and SHIP-OWNERSHIP.
- Production world data: the raider provisioner adds only missing records, so
  live object #70021 needs the keywords `key brass raider`; rerunning the
  derelict provisioner replaces trigger 70010 with the `search` version.
